ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"

# Stage 2: build stage
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /wheels

COPY ./api/pyproject.toml .
COPY ./api/demospipes_addon_bmds_api/ ./demospipes_addon_bmds_api/

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=PIP_BMDS_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=PIP_BMDS_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --extra-index-url "https://${PIP_BMDS_INDEX_USERNAME} \
    :${PIP_BMDS_INDEX_PASSWORD}@<REDACTED>" .

# Stage 3: final stage
FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-api:v1.18.127-main-ce4cc11 AS final

# Copy installed libraries
WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

# Set home to the user's home directory
=== executors ===
# Stage 1: test dependencies stage for CI/CD pipeline
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS test-deps

ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
ENV UV_LINK_MODE=copy
ENV UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=0

WORKDIR /app

# Copy all project files from executors subdirectory
COPY executors/ /app

# Install Python dependencies with dev dependencies for testing
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --dev

# Add virtual environment to PATH so pytest and installed packages are available
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"

# Stage 2: builder stage
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /wheels

COPY ./executors/pyproject.toml .
COPY ./executors/demospipes_addon_bmds_executors/ ./demospipes_addon_bmds_executors/

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --extra-index-url "https://${UV_INDEX_USERNAME} \
    :${UV_INDEX_PASSWORD}@<REDACTED>" .

# Stage 2: final stage
FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-executors:v1.24.195-main-8a31fa9 AS final

USER root

# Copy installed libraries
WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

# Set home to the user's home directory
ENV HOME=/home/user
ENV PREFECT_HOME=$HOME/.prefect

RUN useradd user -u 1001 -g 0 && \
    mkdir -p "$PREFECT_HOME" && chown -R user "$PREFECT_HOME"

USER user

# Update working directory
WORKDIR /app

COPY ./executors/schemas/ ./schemas/
COPY ./executors/scripts/start-workers.sh ./
COPY ./executors/scripts/autorestart-worker.sh ./

# Define port 8000 as default for microservice apps
EXPOSE 8000

# Register in prefect and start prefect workers
CMD ["sh", "start-workers.sh"]
